localizedDescriptions.en: Find CRM records, review opportunities, and check calendars in a HighLevel sub-account.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 搜索 HighLevel 子账号的 CRM 记录、查看销售机会和日历。

en: List the open opportunities in this HighLevel location, grouped by pipeline stage.
zh-CN: 按销售阶段列出此 HighLevel 子账号中尚未关闭的销售机会。

instructions.en: Open Settings → Private Integrations in the HighLevel sub-account, create a token with the scopes you need, and enter the token and the Location ID from the same sub-account.
instructions.zh-CN: 在目标 HighLevel 子账号的「设置 → 私有集成」中创建令牌，勾选需要的权限，再填写该令牌和同一子账号的位置 ID。
